svg.title: SD00 — Run an LLM Task (Template Method, Strategy, Adapter)

g.text: SD00 — Run an LLM Task (Template Method, Strategy, Adapter)
referenced by SD01, SD02, SD06, SD07, SD09
task is any LlmTask subclass, e.g. ActionInterpreter.
It is entered from the subclass's public method (interpret(),
narrate(), reply(), generate(), write(), summarize()), which
calls run(input). run() is the template method; buildPrompt,
parse, isValid and fallback are supplied by the subclass.
focus = what the prompt is about (the NPC's id,
the current location's id, ...): fixed facts and
summaries that mention it are picked first
[attempt ≤ MAX_ATTEMPTS and no valid output yet]
[no valid output: LLM unavailable, timeout, malformed JSON or invalid twice]
